rows.response_text: The Natural Cafe is a casual dining restaurant located at 5892 Hollister Ave, Goleta, CA. Specializing in Tex-Mex, Vegetarian, and Sandwiches, it operates every day from 11:00 to 21:00. It has a 4-star business rating and is known for its fresh, healthy food served in a friendly "help yourself" environment. This includes popular items like the Buddha burrito, lentil soup, and the chocolate milkshake. Customers appreciate the vegan and gluten-free options as well as their salads, soups, and sandwiches. The restaurant offers outdoor seating and is good for groups, but doesn't take reservations. It offers take-out services and has a parking lot and street parking, although no WiFi. The Natural Cafe also offers a pet-friendly patio, as per a review. Customer service is noted to be friendly and quick.
